The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1518c8e1e86bb532), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Under the hypotheses of Lemma 3.2, there is a measurable set S ⊂ TΣ of positive smooth section measure such that every future unit geodesic with seed in S has finite maximal future proper lifetime in the full M and an ambient endpoint on ∂M. The endpoints lie in one compact subset of an ambient chart. Moreover, there are finitely many precompact ambient charts ψj : Uj → Vj ⊂ R4 and constants C < ∞, m > 0 with the following properties: (i) on each entire Vj, the metric and inverse metric have component norms at most C, and ∥e Γj∥L2(Vj) ≤ C; (ii) for every seed in S and every proper time from its intersection with Σ to its full future endpoint, excluding only the endpoint itself, at least one j satisfies dist ψj(γ(τ)), R4 \ Vj  ≥ m, |(ψj)∗γ̇(τ)| ≤ C. (3.2) Here the section measure is the pullback of canonical volume on T∗Σ under w 7→ h(w, ·), where h is the induced metric. In particular it has the same null sets as every smooth positive measure on TΣ.
